scripts.dev: uv run alembic upgrade head && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "pnpm --filter @geoscalex/web dev" "uv run uvicorn geoscalex.api.main:app --reload --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000" "uv run python -m geoscalex.worker.main"
